summary: Verified bug fix v1.0.2 for merchant dashboard crash on item click (Ionicons size string prop). Frontend-only Playwright test on http://localhost:3000 with merchant credentials (0509999999/merchant2025). Login → dashboard succeeded (11 nav tiles rendered). All 11 target screens (products, orders, social, customers, banners, competitions, employees, support-settings, branches, drivers, delivery-settings) navigated successfully with correct URL and NO red-screen / no JS pageerror / no new console errors — including the two newly registered screens (employees, support-settings). Back navigation from every screen returned to /merchant without errors. Grep for legacy `size="<digits>"` in /app/frontend/app/ returns 0 matches, confirming all 41 instances are cleaned. _layout.tsx now contains <Stack.Screen name='employees'/> and <Stack.Screen name='support-settings'/>. NOTE: A minor pre-existing (unrelated) React Native warning fires only on /merchant/social: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — non-fatal, does not crash the screen; likely stray whitespace/JSX between View children in social.tsx (see refs below). Also observed ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for a few external image URLs on social feed (avatars/uploads) — cosmetic, unrelated to this fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fires ~9 times when opening the Social screen. Likely a stray space/newline inside a <View> (e.g., between conditional {expr} blocks) around lines 175-234 or 245-252 of /app/frontend/app/merchant/social.tsx. Non-blocking but should be cleaned so it doesn't become a hard error on newer RN versions.

react_native_issues.issue: Stray text nodes inside <View> containers. Reference: /app/frontend/app/merchant/social.tsx (lines ~175, 196, 226-234, 245-252). Wrap or trim whitespace between JSX siblings to remove console warnings.

action_items: OPTIONAL / LOW: Clean stray whitespace/text nodes inside <View> containers in /app/frontend/app/merchant/social.tsx to silence the 'Unexpected text node' console warning (does not crash the screen).
OPTIONAL: The failing external avatar/upload URLs on /merchant/social produce ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED — either use a fallback Image source or validate stored URLs at write time.
critical_code_review_comments: merchant/_layout.tsx now correctly registers employees and support-settings screens (lines 20-21).
grep -rn 'size="[0-9]' /app/frontend/app/ returns 0 matches — Ionicons size prop is now numeric everywhere in /app/frontend/app/, confirming the reported crash cause is eliminated.
merchant/index.tsx dashboard tiles have proper testID='nav-<id>' allowing reliable automation and all use size={26} (number) for Ionicons.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 merchant screens navigate + back without crash)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing merchant account 0509999999/merchant2025 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The v1.0.2 crash-on-click regression is fixed. If the LOW-priority 'Unexpected text node' warning in merchant/social.tsx is addressed, re-run the same 11-screen navigation loop to confirm 0 console errors. No backend re-run needed for this fix.
rca_of_issue: Confirmed root cause: 41 occurrences of <Ionicons size="NN" .../> (string) instead of size={NN} (number) triggered strict prop-validation crashes on production Hermes/Fabric builds while remaining silent in dev/Metro (which is lenient). Fix: all occurrences converted to numeric literals across 13 files in /app/frontend/app/{merchant,driver,}. Verified via `grep -rn 'size="[0-9]' /app/frontend/app/` returning 0 matches and by clicking every one of the 11 merchant menu tiles in the web preview — no red screen, no pageerror, no navigation failure. Additionally verified the two newly-registered routes (employees, support-settings) in merchant/_layout.tsx resolve to their screens.
